extraction.notes: No 2027 Asheville information was found. Adirondack has posted 2027 dates, but the supplied homepage still lists 2026 camps; this is not a complete 2027 program list. The Asheville page returned no readable text during web verification, so Asheville details use the supplied official-page text. Existing programs contained duplicate names; the overnight card retains X10 Asheville and the day version adds (day) to distinguish the formats.

cards.name: X10 Asheville
cards.description: Campers receive lacrosse instruction and play games, with additional activities including hiking, frisbee, basketball, volleyball, a talent show and campfire. Campers stay in Christ School dormitories.

lunch.text: We have a vegetarian and salad bar available at every lunch and dinner and fruit is served at all meals.

cards.name: X10 Asheville (day)
cards.description: Day campers participate in lacrosse instruction, games and campus activities at Christ School. They attend Monday through Thursday and do not attend Friday departure day.

hours.text: Day Campers arrive at 10:00 on Monday and 9:00 Tues, Wed, Thurs. Day Campers need to be picked up each evening at 7:30 and do not attend Friday.

lunch.text: We have a vegetarian and salad bar available at every lunch and dinner and fruit is served at all meals.
